refusal.journal: the refused payload is not journaled and consumes no attempt; the CP-4 ticket still has no step and the snapshot is unchanged. G1 records it in the owner-run audit (payloads/<raw sha>, payloads/<filled sha>, bindings/<binding hash>, submissions/<record hash>) and in receipt.submissions as an OwnerSubmission with disposition 'refused', issues equal to the frozen issue string, step_sha256 and step_output_sha256 null, and snapshot_after_sha256 equal to the binding snapshot; _verify_submissions replays it
